summary: Full test pass for Rekap Cadangan KAI MVP. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passing (auth login/me, categories, entries CRUD with ownership scoping, admin cross-user visibility, rekap ordering). Frontend: end-to-end mobile viewport flow passing - login, dashboard with 6 category cards, entry create/edit/delete, rekap text generation, copy-to-clipboard (button state -> TERSALIN), session persistence after reload, logout, admin login shows admin-note.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, functional now).

Rekap ordering for admin: keys with unknown owner sort to index 999 (fallback OK), but region label uses owner as fallback when region missing - only happens if seed regions ever absent, currently fine.
seed_data_creation: Test entries prefixed TEST_/UITEST- were created during flow and cleaned up (delete verified with 404 on repeat).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_rekap_api.py covers all key endpoints incl. ownership scoping and admin cross-visibility. Preview URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All testIDs used by frontend are stable and match request spec: login-username-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, dashboard-username, dashboard-logout-button, dashboard-category-<key>, dashboard-rekap-button, entry-nomor-input, entry-keterangan-input, entry-submit-button, entry-row-<idx>, entry-edit-<idx>, entry-delete-<idx>, rekap-text, rekap-copy-button, admin-note.
